independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session 32298593) authored none of the DG1 implementation, and not the round-15 repair 22f3054 (F-DG1-136 + F-DG1-217, T-DG1-BE16, backend-workflow-engineer). cc6fbe3 and f27b5a6 are orchestrator metadata. I raised F-DG1-136 in round 14 and verify it as its originating reviewer. F-DG1-217 was raised by qa-verifier, and I verify it as a qualified non-author, as my assignment directs. At start the real-repo HEAD was c7edc14, not the freeze commit f27b5a6f. c7edc14 is a direct child of f27b5a6f and adds only candidate-excluded metadata: round-15 assignments, the 76d8b304 manifest and stages.json. The recomputed candidate ID is 76d8b304...7846 in the real repo and in a full (not shallow) disposable clone checked out at f27b5a6f (00-candidate-identity.log). Candidate identity is the content hash, and the commit is a traceability pointer (CLAUDE.md), so I proceeded, as in rounds 11-14. During my run HEAD advanced to 5d5e8a2, the runner's auto-commit of the domain reviewer's round-15 run. I checked only its directory NAMES, and the ID is still 76d8b304 (50-cleanup.log). I formed this verdict before, and without, reading any other reviewer's round-15 record. I did not open any of them.
